title: Improper restriction of rendered ui layers or frames in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized…
description: CVE-2026-20942 is a medium severity vulnerability in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) involving improper restriction of rendered UI layers or frames. This flaw allows an unauthorized attacker to perform spoofing attacks over a network by manipulating the user interface presentation. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality, integrity, or availability beyond the potential for user interface spoofing.
